recommend: Park with R2 (stop rule: no inductive form for C/C0 found). If revived, one Big-Y stage: show Y_e >= 2^(bitlen N_e + 1) only right after an exact-power epoch (Y = 2^m), where C then needs only popcount(N - v + 1) >= 2 - s.
mechanism: Hub K(a,b,T) = 0^inf (101)^a 00 (101)^b A> cells(T) 0^inf, with T read from the head cell in tokens 0=000, 1=001, j=010, t=10. R1 adds 1 to T (j transparent; the t case is a cascade inc(tR) = j inc(sigma(inc R))). At b=0 the low digits pick E (0 1^r j^k: eat into blocks) or a bell B0/B1 (sweep, then the one-cell shift sigma). sigma of a clean word leaves exactly one t at its first j. The t walks through the j's and vanishes at increment 2^P, P = #0 bits of Y = value(V) + sum_j 2^depth(j) below the last j. In integers a clean word is (digit value v, multiset M of j depths); the cleanup maps M to {Z_d(Y)} + {Z_p(Y): p a 1 bit of Y} (Z_x = zeros of Y below x) and the b=0 steps act on the potential U = n + sum 2^d as E: (U+2)/2^mu - 2, B0: (U+2)/2^(r+1) - 1, B1: U + 1. Lemma S: the bell after epoch e is safe whenever zb(Y_e) <= bitlen(N_e) - 1 + s_e (s = eat shift), or s = 0 and Y_e = 2^bitlen(N_e); so non-halting reduces to the Big-Y lemma: Y_e >= 2^(bitlen N_e + 1) implies zb(Y_e) <= bitlen(N_e) - 1 + s_e.

model.tokens: cells right of the hub head, read from the head cell: 0=000, 1=001, j=010 (3 cells), t=10 (2 cells); bad 011 (halt), 11
model.inc: inc(eps)=1; inc(0R)=1R; inc(1R)=0 inc(R); inc(jR)=j inc(R); inc(tR)=j inc(sigma(inc R))
model.sigma: drop one cell: on a clean word 0->0, 1->j before the first j, first j -> t, rest unchanged
model.cleanup: V = word the bell shifts; d_i = depths (#digit tokens before) of V's j's, f = d_k; Y = value(V) + sum 2^d_i; t gone at increment exactly 2^P, P = #zero bits of Y in [0,f); afterwards Y's 1 bits are j, 0 bits slots, top j at depth zb(Y), value = increments since the bell

remaining_gaps: L*: 2^zb(Y_e) <= N_e for every epoch e >= 16. It holds at all 100,000 epochs to N = 1,091,790 except 7, 8, 14 and 15, but its margin shrinks: 0.687 bits to 20,000 epochs, 0.319 at epoch 62,386 (N = 654,227). So it may not be the right inductive form.

The needed bound 2^P(e) <= N_e keeps min log2 N - P = 2.32 bits for N >= 100 (0.64 overall, epoch 8). A direct inductive proof needs a crossing lemma on the potential Y (the same arithmetic as R2's R1).
